rows.note: Use this for someone with a muscular, well-built physique rather than for general physical activity.

example.english: He has an athletic, muscular build.
example.jyutping: keoi5 san1 jing4 hou2 gin6 sek6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for describing a physically active person.

example.english: I was athletic and always running around as a child.
example.traditional: 我細個嗰陣好動，成日周圍跑。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 hou3 dung6 sing4 jat6 zau1 wai4 paau2

rows.note: Use this for a sports move or play that demands a high level of physical skill.

example.english: This is an athletic gymnastics move with a high level of difficulty.
example.traditional: 呢個體操動作係高難度。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 tai2 cou1 dung6 zok3 hai6 gou1 naan4 dou6

rows.note: Use this construction when something is related to athletes, with N standing for 運動員 or a similar noun.

example.english: This plan is related to athletic training.
example.traditional: 呢個計劃同運動員訓練有關。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 tung4 wan6 dung6 jyun4 fan3 lin6 jau5 gwaan1
